findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: Observed no sanitizer solution to be set up upon inspection. Discussed with PIC, sanitizer bucket was made and tested at 200 ppm Quat. Ensure a sanitizer solution is prepared during all hours of operation.
findings.citation_text: 4-303.11(A) Cleaning Agents and Sanitizers, Availability. (A) Cleaning agents that are used to clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-6, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Observed the pizza prep cooler to be soiled with food splash. Discussed with PIC, cooler will be cleaned. Ensure non food contact surfaces are being cleaned at a frequency that prevents food splash accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
3-501.16: Observed creamer machine at an internal temperature of 71 degrees F. Stopped operation of machine, and machine was removed from service. PIC has placed a work order for a new machine and so the facility will not utilize this creamer station until proper cold holding is available. Ensure cold holding units are checked daily for proper temperature. 
3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
4-501.11: Observed the gasket on the bottom of the left door of the pizza prep cooler to be in a state of disrepair. PIC has placed a work order to replace said item. Ensure gaskets remain in good repair to be smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable. 
4-501.11: (A) EQUIPMENT shall be maintained in good repair. (B) EQUIPMENT components shall be kept intact, tight, and adjusted to manufacturer’s specifications. (C) Cutting or piercing parts of can opens shall be kept sharp to minimize metal fragmentation.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The following areas were observed to have an accumulation of dust/debris: 
-Rack above pizza prep cooler
-Left side of slushee machine, near air intake
Ensure the listed areas are cleaned to remove the current accumulation of dust/debris. Ensure the cleaning continues at a frequency necessary to maintain cleanliness of these areas. 
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: Light under the right side of hood system observed to have water accumulation in the glass case. PIC has submitted a work order to fix said item. Ensure repairs are made to prevent water accumulation in the glass case. 
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: The following areas were observed to have accumulated dust/debris:
-Light casings in the kitchen
-Wall behind storage rack above triple sink
-Counter under Cappuccino machine. 
Ensure these places are clean to remove the accumulated dust/debris. Ensure to keep areas clean of dust/debris accumulation. 
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114  (P) Quaternary ammonium sanitizers should be maintained at 200 ppm to 400 ppm per the manufacturer's label. The only sani bucket observed in the facility during the inspection was observed at 0 ppm. The bucket was remade to correct.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.comment:
750-810b Moist cloths used for wiping food spills on kitchenware and food-contact surfaces shall be clean and rinsed frequently in one of the permitted sanitizing solutions. See Section 750.820e.   These cloths shall be stored in a proper sanitizing solution between uses.
The bucket of sanitizer stationed at the front desk was reading 0 ppm Quat. Quat sanitizers should be between 150 and 400 ppm. Discussed with the person in charge and the bucket was redone to the correct concentration during the inspection.

findings.title: Cross-contamination, equipment, personnel, storage
findings.comment: 750-160  Food shall be protected at all times from cross-contamination. Observed slime and mold growing in the ice machine at the back of the facility, and dripping into the ice being used for consumption.

findings.title: Sanitizing concentration
findings.comment: 750-800a Tableware shall be washed, rinsed and sanitized after each use. No sanitizer bucket was observed during inspection and procedure given by employee suggested that a spray bottle was used instead of a bucket. This allows bacteria to grow between uses on the wiping cloths.

findings.title: Original container, properly labeled, consumer advisory
findings.comment:
Observed a bulk container to have no label. The container shall be marked with the proper common name.
750-130f Unless its identity is unmistakable, bulk food such as cooking oil, syrup, salt, sugar or flour not stored in the product container or package in which it was obtained, shall be stored in a container identifying the food by common name.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment:
Observed creamer and iced coffee to have no date mark. The potentially hazardous items must be date marked and used within seven days.
750-151(a) Refrigerated potentially hazardous ready to eat food held at the establishment more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked with the date or day by which the food shall be consumed, sold, or discarded. Maximum holding time at 41°F is 7 days. Properly date mark food and do not hold longer than 7 days.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
Observed no bleach test kit for the sanitizer bottle. Provide a bleach test kit.
750-830g A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.

findings.title: Sanitizing concentration
findings.comment:
Observed the bleach sanitizer bottle that is used for cleaning surfaces is >200ppm. The bleach was remade to measure ~50 ppm. Make sure to use test strips for sanitizer bottles.
750-160 In an effort to prevent the transmission of pathogenic organisms, food shall be prepared with the least possible manual contact, with suitable utensils and on surfaces that prior to use have been cleaned, rinsed and sanitized to prevent cross-contamination.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Observed the ice machine flap to be soiled with mold accumulation. Before filling the ice machine back up, wash, rinse and sanitize the food contact surface.
750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment:
Observed iced coffee that did not have a date mark. The iced coffee was dated during the inspection. Make sure to date mark any potentially hazardous foods and use within 7 days or discard.
750-151(a) Refrigerated potentially hazardous food held at the establishment more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked with the ate or day by which the food shall be consumed, sold, or discarded. Maximum holding time at 41°F is 7 days. Properly date mark food and do not hold longer than 7 days.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
Observed ribs in the walk in freezer to not be protected. The ribs and other foods must be protected or covered at all times.
750-120(a) Food shall be protected at all times. Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed the men's restroom handsink's plug to be broken. Caulk or repair the handsink.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Hand washing sinks installed, located, accessible
findings.comment:
Observed the handsink in the back area near the ice machine to be blocked. The handsink was made accessible during the inspection.
750-1120(b) Lavatories shall be accessible to employees at all times.

findings.title: Rooms clean, lockers provided and used, clean
findings.comment:
Observed a coat on the food prep shelf. Coats must be stored separately. The coat was removed during the inspection.
750-1280 Adequate area must be provided for the storage of employee belongings segregated from the food preparation and food storage area to reduce the potential for cross contamination.  Properly store all employee belongings.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment:
1) Observed sausage used for pizza to have no date in the bottom of the prep cooler.  The sausage was discarded because employees did not know when the sausage was placed in the container. 2) Observed sausage gravy to be at 77 F.  Employee stated that gravy is turned off to cool.  Make sure to pull the gravy after it is unplugged to ensure that no one uses it.
750-150(b)  Hot potentially hazardous foods shall be maintained at 135°F or above except during the cooling process. Store hot foods at 135°F or above. (Except for rare roast beef which may be held at 130F.)
750-151(a) Refrigerated potentially hazardous food held at the establishment more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked with the ate or day by which the food shall be consumed, sold, or discarded. Maximum holding time at 41°F is 7 days. Properly date mark food and do not hold longer than 7 days.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.comment:
Observed no thermometer in the cold sandwich prep cooler.
Provide a thermometer.
findings.citation_text: 750.140(a) All refrigeration units used to hold potentially hazardous foods shall contain a  conspicuously placed thermometer that is accurate to ±3°F.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
Observed chicken wings stored on the floor in the walk in freezer.  All food must be stored at least 6 " off the floor.
750-130(b) Food shall be stored at least 6 inches off the floor.  Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed some spatula's that are cracked.  Discard spatulas.
750-650a Food contact surfaces shall be smooth, non absorbent, easily cleanable, and free of breaks, open seams, cracks, chips, pits, and free of difficult-to-clean internal corners and crevices.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Observed both coffee spots to be soiled.  Clean the coffee spouts.
750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
Observed plastic cups and pizza cardboard boxes stored on the floor.  Single service items must be at least 6" off the floor.
750-880 Single-service articles shall be handled and dispensed in a manner which prevents contamination of surfaces which may come in contact with food or with the mouth of the user.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water disposed properly
findings.comment:
Observed waste water sitting in mop bucket that was used earlier in the day.  Waste water must be disposed of properly and immediately after use.  The mop water was properly disposed.
750-1050 All water containing sewage shall be disposed of  properly either by a public sewage system or an approved private disposal system which is constructed and operated in conformance with applicable State and local laws, ordinances and regulations.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
There is a leak at the handsink near the pizza prep cooler.  Repair the leak.
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Observed no drain cover at the mopsink.  The cover was placed on the drain.
750-1200 The junctures between walls and floors shall be coved and sealed, or shall not present an opening of more that 1/32 of an inch.
